caseNameFull: Forsham v. Califano, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. Certiorari granted, and case set for oral argument in tandem with No. 78-1088, Kissinger v. Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press, and No. 78-1217, Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press v. Kissinger [certiorari granted, ante, p. 904].
